description: This file is a shell script used for testing the compatibility of object formats in a Git repository, specifically testing sha1 and sha256 hash functions, signatures, and object referencing.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Determines the hash function to use for object compatibility, switching between sha1 and sha256.

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for the 'hello' blob based on the hash type.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for the tree object based on the hash type.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for the commit object based on the hash type.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for the secondary commit object based on the hash type.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes a signature from the commit object based on the provided hash type.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes a signature or trailer from a tag object based on storage and delete type.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Function that compares the integrity and consistency of object IDs across different hash formats in multiple repositories.
